pages.title: Mobile Garlic Diffuser
pages.text: Hunter maids can become a $(bold)mobile garlic diffuser$()!$(br2)Simply place any type of $(item)Garlic Diffuser$() (normal/improved/weak) and $(item)Purified Garlic$() as fuel in the maid's backpack. The maid will automatically create a garlic effect area centered on herself.$(br2)The garlic effect consumes Purified Garlic as fuel, using 1 every 2 minutes. Vampires entering the maid's vicinity will take garlic damage.
